hosts.purpose: Mod search, project pages, hash lookups, mod downloads and icons (api / cdn)
hosts.sends: Search text you type, project ids, and SHA-1/SHA-512 hashes of mod files you have installed (to find updates).

hosts.purpose: Microsoft device-code sign-in
hosts.sends: Only when you add a Microsoft account: the sign-in handshake. Luminos never sees your password.

hosts.purpose: Xbox Live token step of Microsoft sign-in
hosts.sends: Sign-in tokens for the account you add.

hosts.purpose: XSTS token step of Microsoft sign-in
hosts.sends: Sign-in tokens for the account you add.

hosts.purpose: Minecraft profile for Microsoft accounts, and the "is this name premium?" check when you type a username
hosts.sends: Your Minecraft access token (Microsoft accounts only), or the username you typed.

hosts.purpose: Look up a player's UUID when you copy their skin by name
hosts.sends: The username you typed.

hosts.purpose: Read that player's current skin address
hosts.sends: The UUID of the player you looked up.

hosts.purpose: Download the skin PNG you chose to copy
hosts.sends: Nothing about you.

hosts.purpose: Ely.by sign-in (authlib-injector)
hosts.sends: Only when you add an Ely.by account: the username and password you type, sent over HTTPS to Ely.by.

hosts.purpose: Fetch a skin by username when you import one
hosts.sends: The username you typed.

hosts.purpose: Fallback skin lookup by username
hosts.sends: The username you typed.
